abstract: Covers the EU Artificial Intelligence Act, Regulation (EU) 2024/1689, with two version lines: the consolidated text of 27 July 2026 that incorporates the Digital Omnibus on AI, Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 (current), and the original text of 12 July 2024 (legacy, upgraded from). It turns the engineering-relevant obligations into requirements: operator roles, prohibited practices (Art. 5), high-risk classification (Art. 6, Annex III), high-risk requirements (Arts. 9 to 15) and Annex IV documentation, logging and retention (Arts. 12, 19, 26), transparency and content marking (Art. 50), general-purpose AI model obligations (Arts. 51 to 56) and the GPAI Code of Practice, and the application dates (Arts. 111, 113). It is not legal advice and tells the user to involve counsel.
